verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment that any field can be turned into a custom search dimension in a couple of clicks (datadog-comm-13). That shows ad-hoc grouping and filtering on arbitrary fields is possible, but it still needs a lightweight definition step rather than working with zero setup. The Log Management and APM doc entries are titles only and say nothing about high-cardinality querying. Missing for 10: documentation that grouping and filtering on high-cardinality fields like user or request IDs works without pre-defining facets or indexes, any evidence on cardinality limits or performance, and independent hands-on corroboration.
